hook: Fifteen questions, no second chances. Can you score fifteen out of fifteen? Let us find out.

questions.question: Which dinosaur's name means king of the tyrant lizards?
questions.question_speech: Question one. Which dinosaur's name means king of the tyrant lizards? A. Tyrannosaurus rex. B. Velociraptor. C. Stegosaurus. D. Triceratops.

questions.question: How many horns did Triceratops have on its face?
questions.question_speech: Question two. How many horns did Triceratops have on its face? A. Four. B. Two. C. One. D. Three.

questions.question: What does the word dinosaur mean?
questions.question_speech: Question three. What does the word dinosaur mean? A. Fierce claw. B. Terrible lizard. C. Ancient reptile. D. Giant bird.

questions.question: Which dinosaur is known for bony back plates and a spiked tail?
questions.question_speech: Question four. Which dinosaur is known for bony back plates and a spiked tail? A. Diplodocus. B. Ankylosaurus. C. Stegosaurus. D. Brachiosaurus.

questions.question: Which of these geological periods came first?
questions.question_speech: Question five. Which of these geological periods came first? A. Paleogene. B. Triassic. C. Cretaceous. D. Jurassic.

questions.question: Which of these was a flying reptile, not a dinosaur?
questions.question_speech: Question six. Which of these was a flying reptile, not a dinosaur? A. Stegosaurus. B. Velociraptor. C. Pteranodon. D. Triceratops.

questions.question: What do we call scientists who study fossils?
questions.question_speech: Question seven. What do we call scientists who study fossils? A. Biologists. B. Geologists. C. Archaeologists. D. Paleontologists.

questions.question: Which small, fast dinosaur had a sickle-shaped claw on each foot?
questions.question_speech: Question eight. Which small, fast dinosaur had a sickle-shaped claw on each foot? A. Velociraptor. B. Triceratops. C. Spinosaurus. D. Iguanodon.

questions.question: About when did the non-bird dinosaurs go extinct?
questions.question_speech: Question nine. About when did the non-bird dinosaurs go extinct? A. 10,000 years ago. B. 200 million years ago. C. 66 million years ago. D. 6 million years ago.
questions.answer_speech: C is correct, 66 million years ago.

questions.question: What is widely believed to have helped cause the dinosaur extinction?
questions.question_speech: Question ten. What is widely believed to have helped cause the dinosaur extinction? A. A volcanic island. B. An asteroid impact. C. A giant flood. D. An ice age cycle.
questions.answer_speech: B is correct, An asteroid impact.

questions.question: Which living animals are descended from dinosaurs?
questions.question_speech: Question eleven. Which living animals are descended from dinosaurs? A. Lizards. B. Frogs. C. Crocodiles. D. Birds.

questions.question: Where is the Chicxulub impact crater located?
questions.question_speech: Question twelve. Where is the Chicxulub impact crater located? A. Mexico. B. Australia. C. Egypt. D. Canada.

questions.question: What are fossilized dinosaur droppings called?
questions.question_speech: Question thirteen. What are fossilized dinosaur droppings called? A. Gastroliths. B. Coprolites. C. Trilobites. D. Amber.

questions.question: Which giant long-necked dinosaur is among the largest land animals ever known?
questions.question_speech: Question fourteen. Which giant long-necked dinosaur is among the largest land animals ever known? A. Gallimimus. B. Compsognathus. C. Ankylosaurus. D. Argentinosaurus.

questions.question: How did dinosaurs reproduce?
questions.question_speech: Question fifteen. How did dinosaurs reproduce? A. By splitting. B. By live birth. C. By laying eggs. D. By budding.
questions.answer_speech: C is correct, By laying eggs.
